수고하셨습니다.forms: polite: 수고하셨어요 · casual: 수고했어 · leaving: 수고하세요
수고하셨습니다.m: thank you for your hard work; good work
수고하셨습니다.x: Thank you for all your hard work today. See you tomorrow.
수고하셨습니다.e: Literally 'you received hardship' — thanks for the effort.
수고하셨습니다.t: Common at the end of a workday or task. When leaving a shop, people often say 수고하세요.

시끄럽다.e: 시끄러워! = 'It's so loud! / Be quiet!' — often heard in dramas.

맵다.x: The tteokbokki is a bit spicy.
맵다.e: 매워요! When ordering, ask for 덜 맵게 (less spicy).
맵다.t: Useful at restaurants: 안 맵게 해 주세요 = 'Please make it not spicy.'

성실하다.ex: 그 학생은 성실해서 숙제를 항상 해 와요.
성실하다.x: That student is conscientious, so they always do their homework.
성실하다.e: Literally 'sincere and true' — someone you can count on.

깨끗이.forms: 깨끗이 씻다 · 깨끗이 청소하다 · 깨끗이 먹다 (eat it all up)
깨끗이.ex: 밥 먹기 전에 손을 깨끗이 씻으세요.
깨끗이.x: Wash your hands well before you eat.
깨끗이.t: Spelled 깨끗이, not 깨끗히 — a spelling mistake even native speakers make.

갑자기.ex: 길을 걷는데 갑자기 비가 내리기 시작했어요.
갑자기.x: I was walking down the street when it suddenly started raining.

성함.x: Excuse me, may I have your name?
성함.e: Literally 'surname and title': the respectful word for a person's full name.
성함.t: The plain word is 이름; use 성함 when asking elders, customers or anyone you don't know well. For your own name always say 이름.

까다롭다.x: My father is very picky about food.
까다롭다.e: Works for people (picky) and for tasks or rules (tricky).
까다롭다.t: Use N에 까다롭다 for 'picky about N': 음식에 까다롭다, 옷에 까다롭다.

관람객.m: spectator, visitor (to a show or exhibition)
관람객.ex: 이번 전시회에는 관람객이 매일 천 명 넘게 와요.
관람객.x: Over a thousand visitors come to this exhibition every day.

액션.ex: 이 영화는 액션 장면이 정말 멋있어요.
액션.x: The action scenes in this movie are really cool.
액션.t: On film sets, the director calls 레디, 액션! 'Ready, action!'

사회성.ex: 그 아이는 사회성이 좋아서 친구가 많아요.
사회성.x: That child has good social skills, so he has lots of friends.
사회성.e: -성 = quality or nature: 사회성, 가능성, 중요성.
사회성.t: 사회성이 좋다 / 사회성이 부족하다 = to have good / poor social skills.

엑스레이.x: I got an X-ray to see if my arm was broken.
엑스레이.e: From English 'X-ray'; the letter X is said 엑스.
엑스레이.t: You 'take' an X-ray with 찍다: 엑스레이를 찍다.

재수생.m: student retaking the college entrance exam (after a year of study)
재수생.ex: 재수생은 일 년 동안 학원에서 수능을 준비해요.
재수생.x: Repeat students spend a year preparing for the CSAT at cram schools.

악보.ex: 저는 악보를 볼 줄 몰라서 귀로 듣고 연주해요.
악보.x: I can't read sheet music, so I play by ear.
악보.t: 'To read sheet music' is 악보를 보다 or 악보를 읽다.

앞장서다.m: to take the lead, lead the way; to spearhead
앞장서다.x: She led the way in the environmental protection movement.

등을 돌리다.forms: 등을 돌려요 · 등을 돌렸어요 · N에게 등을 돌리다
등을 돌리다.m: to turn one's back on, to abandon, to break with
등을 돌리다.ex: 가격이 너무 올라서 손님들이 그 가게에 등을 돌렸어요.
등을 돌리다.x: Prices went up too much, so customers turned their backs on that store.
등을 돌리다.e: Literally 'to turn one's back,' the same image as in English.
rel: to look away from, to ignore

상호.x: The two countries pledged mutual cooperation.
상호.t: Homonym: 상호 also means 'business name', as on a store sign.

적대감.ex: 두 나라 사이의 적대감이 점점 커지고 있습니다.
적대감.x: Hostility between the two countries is steadily growing.
적대감.e: Literally 'the feeling of facing an enemy'.

정전.x: The armistice agreement was signed on July 27, 1953.
정전.t: Homonym: 정전 (停電) more often means 'power outage' in daily life.

정전.x: The power went out last night, so we lit candles.
정전.t: Say 정전이 되다 'the power goes out'; homonym 정전 停戰 means 'ceasefire'.

갑질.m: abuse of power over subordinates, high-handed treatment by someone in a superior position
갑질.ex: 손님의 갑질 때문에 직원들이 많이 힘들어해요.
갑질.x: The staff are having a hard time because of customers who treat them like dirt.
갑질.e: 갑 is 'party A' (the stronger side) in contracts, plus -질, a suffix for disapproved actions.
갑질.t: -질 often marks a disapproved action, as in 도둑질 (stealing) and 갑질.

각본.ex: 그 영화는 감독이 직접 각본을 썼어요.
각본.x: The director wrote that movie's screenplay himself.
각본.e: Literally 'role book' — the text actors perform from.
각본.t: 각본 없는 드라마 (a drama without a script) is a common phrase for an exciting real-life sports game.

확진.ex: 어제 검사를 받았는데 확진 판정이 나왔어요.
확진.x: I got tested yesterday, and it came back positive.
확진.t: 확진자 (confirmed patient) became an everyday word during the COVID-19 pandemic.

경감하다.m: to reduce, to lighten, to alleviate (a burden)
경감하다.ex: 정부는 서민의 세금 부담을 경감하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.
경감하다.x: The government is working to reduce the tax burden on ordinary people.

자못.ex: 결과가 어떻게 나올지 모두 자못 궁금해했어요.
자못.x: Everyone was quite curious about how the results would turn out.
자못.e: A literary word, easy to confuse with 사뭇 'strikingly'.

애지중지.x: Grandma raised her only grandson with loving care.
애지중지.t: Works as an adverb or verb: 애지중지 키우다, 애지중지하다.

정치권.m: political circles, the political world, politicians
정치권.ex: 정치권은 이 문제를 두고 의견이 엇갈리고 있어요.
정치권.x: Politicians are divided over this issue.
정치권.e: -권 = sphere or zone: 정치권, 수도권, 영어권.

명세서.ex: 이번 달 카드 명세서를 보고 깜짝 놀랐어요.
명세서.x: I was shocked when I saw this month's credit card statement.

통설.ex: 새로운 연구 결과가 기존의 통설을 뒤집었어요.
통설.x: New research findings overturned the generally accepted view.

기술격차.ex: 선진국과 개발도상국의 기술격차가 점점 커지고 있습니다.
기술격차.x: The technology gap between developed and developing countries is growing.
기술격차.e: Literally 'technology level difference'; 격차 means a gap or disparity.
기술격차.t: 격차가 벌어지다 'a gap widens' and 격차를 줄이다 'narrow a gap' are common collocations.

인물형.ex: 흥부는 착하고 순진한 인물형을 대표하는 주인공이에요.
인물형.x: Heungbu is a main character who represents the kind, innocent type.

협화음.x: Consonant chords sound stable and comfortable to the ear.

협동조합.ex: 농민들이 협동조합을 만들어 농산물을 직접 팔고 있어요.
협동조합.x: The farmers formed a cooperative and sell their produce directly.
협동조합.t: Pronounced [협똥조합]: ㄷ after ㅂ becomes tense.

종내.ex: 그는 종내 아무 말도 하지 않았어요.
종내.x: In the end, he didn't say a word.
종내.e: Literally 'at the end, then'; a literary word for 끝내.

타초경사.m: tipping off the enemy by acting carelessly
타초경사.ex: 섣불리 조사를 시작하면 타초경사가 될 수 있어요.
타초경사.x: Starting the investigation too hastily could tip them off.
타초경사.e: Literally 'beat the grass and startle the snake.'
